Container.Name: wyoming-whisper
Container.Overview:
Wyoming Faster Whisper is the official Home Assistant speech-to-text server (the same engine as the Whisper add-on) for Assist voice pipelines, using the Wyoming protocol. Despite the name it includes several engines: faster-whisper (100 languages), NVIDIA Parakeet through sherpa-onnx (fast and accurate on CPU), Qwen3-ASR, GigaAM and Hugging Face transformers.
**Setup**
1. Start the container. The first start downloads the model into the Data folder (allow a few minutes; the health check waits 5 minutes). 2. In Home Assistant go to Settings > Devices & services > Add integration > **Wyoming Protocol**, and enter your Unraid IP and port 10300. 3. Settings > Voice assistants > your assistant > Speech-to-text: pick faster-whisper and your language.
**Choosing a model**
Leave Library and Model on `auto` for good defaults. For English, auto uses Parakeet TDT 0.6b v2 via sherpa-onnx, one of the best CPU options. For most other languages it uses faster-whisper `base-int8`. Better accuracy for other languages: `small-int8` or `medium-int8`, Parakeet v3 (`sherpa-onnx-nemo-parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-int8`, 25 European languages), `rhasspy/qwen3-asr-0.6b-onnx-int4-merged` (Qwen3-ASR, 31 languages), or any faster-whisper model from Hugging Face such as `Systran/faster-distil-whisper-small.en`. Bigger models are slower and need more RAM.
**Configuration**
Every command-line option has a `WYO_WHISPER_*` variable (option name in capitals, dashes as underscores); the most useful ones are below. Add others with "Add another Path, Port, Variable", for example `WYO_WHISPER_VAD_CLIP` (trim silence before transcription; set to e.g. `sherpa` or `faster-whisper`) or `WYO_WHISPER_ZEROCONF` (mDNS discovery, needs host networking). Do not add those two empty: an empty value turns them on. Change the port with the port mapping (or `WYO_WHISPER_URI`), not Post Arguments, so the health check keeps working.
**GPU:** the published image is CPU only (amd64 and arm64). A CUDA image can be built from `Dockerfile.gpu` in the repository.
Home Assistant docs: https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/wyoming/

Container.Requires: Home Assistant with the Wyoming Protocol integration

Config.Name: Wyoming Port
Config.Description: Wyoming protocol port. Add it in Home Assistant as host = your Unraid IP, port = this value.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Downloaded models and caches. Several GB for large models.

Config.Name: Language
Config.Description: Default language code, e.g. en, de, fr, or auto. Home Assistant also sends the pipeline language with every request.

Config.Name: STT Library
Config.Description: Speech engine. auto picks one by language (English = sherpa/Parakeet).

Config.Name: Model
Config.Description: auto, tiny-int8, base-int8, small-int8, medium-int8, a sherpa-onnx model id (e.g. sherpa-onnx-nemo-parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-int8) or a Hugging Face repo (e.g. Systran/faster-whisper-large-v3).

Config.Name: CPU Threads
Config.Description: Threads for faster-whisper, sherpa-onnx and qwen3-asr.

Config.Name: Beam Size
Config.Description: Decoding beam size. 0 = auto (1 on ARM, 5 otherwise). Lower is faster.

Config.Name: Compute Type
Config.Description: faster-whisper only: default, int8, int8_float16, float16 or float32.

Config.Name: Initial Prompt
Config.Description: Optional text to bias recognition (faster-whisper, qwen3-asr). Breaks Distil-Whisper models.

Config.Name: Whisper Task
Config.Description: transcribe, or translate speech to English (Whisper models).

Config.Name: VAD Filter
Config.Description: faster-whisper only: Silero voice activity filter, reduces hallucinations on silence.

Config.Name: VAD Endpointing (seconds)
Config.Description: Optional, e.g. 0.7: the server ends the command after this much silence instead of waiting for Home Assistant.

Config.Name: Sherpa Streaming
Config.Description: True streaming recognition with a streaming sherpa model (Kroko zipformer, en/de/es/fr).

Config.Name: Home Assistant Token
Config.Description: Optional admin long-lived token. Biases recognition toward the names of your exposed entities, areas and floors (faster-whisper and qwen3-asr).

Config.Name: Home Assistant API URL
Config.Description: Home Assistant API URL for name biasing (must end in /api).

Config.Name: Local Files Only
Config.Description: Never download models; fail if the model is missing (offline use).
